+# Authentication Flow
+
+## Overview
+This module handles user authentication via AWS Cognito.
+
+## Usage
+```typescript
+import { AuthService } from './auth.service';
+
+const authService = new AuthService();
+await authService.login(username, password);
+```
+
+## Methods
+- `login(username, password)`: Authenticates user
+- `logout()`: Ends user session
+- `refreshToken()`: Renews access token
+
+## Error Handling
+All methods throw AuthError on failure.
